notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
The creature dies, triggering Basri's Lieutenant's second ability, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Knight.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
